q: What do we know about feat-app-bureau-v10-band in the application-scorecard project?
a: feat-app-bureau-v10-band (2026-07-10) is ten bands cut from the isotonic-mapped v10 bureau score, aligned with the bureau-score-migration cut points. It adds Gini 0.03 on holdout-2025q1 (0.41 to 0.44, exp-505) and is used in app-scorecard-v4.

q: What came of exp-501, the reject inference test, in the application-scorecard project?
a: exp-501 parcelled the 8,400 manual approvals and lifted KS on holdout-2025q1 (n=21,300) from 0.36 to 0.38. This became find-app-reject-inference-gain (2025-05-12) and the sample weights in app-gbm-v2.

q: What does app-scorecard-v4 depend on in the application-scorecard project?
a: app-scorecard-v4 depends on app-gbm-v2 (reject-inference weights), feat-app-bureau-v10-band (ten v10 bands) and feat-app-income-est (income band from the inc-gbm-v3 estimate).

q: What is the current approval cutoff for new-account applications in the application-scorecard project?
a: The cutoff is 592 on the v4 points scale from 2026-11-01 (dec-app-cutoff-v4, 2026-10-27). It replaces the v3 cutoff of 585 in dec-app-cutoff-v3.

q: What Gini did app-scorecard-v4 reach on application-scorecard-oot-2026h1, and what did app-scorecard-v3 reach on the same set?
a: app-scorecard-v4 reached Gini 0.42 on application-scorecard-oot-2026h1 (n=61,700 applications, outcomes to 2026-10-15). app-scorecard-v3 reached 0.35 on the same set.

q: Why was the new-account scorecard rebuilt as v4 in the application-scorecard project?
a: The v3 Gini fell from 0.41 to 0.33 on the 2026-Q1 holdout (find-app-gini-v3-drift), driven by bureau score drift. dec-app-rebuild-v4 (2026-06-26) approved the rebuild with v10 bands, reject inference and the income estimate.
